title: 有馬記念（シニア）にむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Arima Kinen, and the crowd is excited to see Special Week and Grass Wonder face off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, opportunity comes when no one is looking. With ideas flowing, Seiun Sky the tactician is back and ready to make this race something no one expects.
